'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[2024 Syrian opposition offensives]]
***[[Operation Dawn of Freedom]]
****[[Manbij offensive (2024)|Manbij offensive]]
*****[[Turkey|Turkish]]-backed [[Syrian National Army]] forces conduct extensive [[Drone warfare|drone strikes]] and [[Artillery|artillery shelling]] on villages near [[United States|U.S.]]-backed [[Kurdish population|Kurdish]] [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] positions in the city of [[Manbij]] in [[Aleppo Governorate]], [[Syria]]. [https://www.motabaat.com/2024/12/07/%D8%A8%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%B1-%D8%B9%D9%86-%D9%82%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%B3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%85%D9%82%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B7%D9%8A%D8%A9/ (Motabaat)] [https://aawsat.com/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%%20D8%A8%D9%8A/%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B4%D8%B%201%D9%82-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A8%D9%8A/5089231-%D8%B3%D%209%88%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%85%D9%82%D8%20%B1%D8%A7%D8%B7%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%AA%D9%87%D9%85-%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%83%D9%20%8A%D8%A7-%D8%A8%D8%B4%D9%86-%D9%87%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D9%88%D8%A7%%20D8%B3%D8%B9%D8%A9-%D8%A8%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%81-%D8%AD%D9%84%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%20%D8%B4%D8%B1%D9%82%D9%8A (''Asharq Al-Awsat'')]
***[[Fall of Damascus (2024)|Fall of Damascus]]
****The [[Military Operations Command (Syria)|Military Operations Command]] coalition led by [[Tahrir al-Sham]] says that a [[military operation]] to capture [[Damascus]] is underway with rebels reportedly advancing on the capital on several fronts. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-832357 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
****Rebel forces capture the cities of [[Al-Dumayr]] and [[Yabroud]] and the town of [[Sa'sa', Syria|Sa'sa']] in [[Rif Dimashq Governorate]] as the [[Ministry of Defense (Syria)|Syrian Defense Ministry]] denies reports that its troops are abandoning positions in the Damascus countryside. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2024/12/07/syrian-opposition-secures-sanamayn-near-damascus-commander-says (Al Arabiya)] [https://www.syriahr.com/%d8%a8%d8%b9%d8%af-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%a7%d9%86%d8%b3%d8%ad%d8%a7%d8%a8-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%83%d8%a8%d9%8a%d8%b1-%d9%81%d9%8a-%d8%b1%d9%8a%d9%81-%d8%af%d9%85%d8%b4%d9%82-%d9%88%d9%85%d8%af%d9%86-%d9%85%d8%aa/739738/ (SOHR)]
****Syrian security officials and Arab officials say that [[First Lady of Syria]] [[Asma al-Assad]] fled with her three children to [[Russia]] last week. However, amid conflicting reports, [[Syrian Arab News Agency|Syrian state television]] says that [[President of Syria|President]] [[Bashar al-Assad]] remains in Damascus. [https://www.yahoo.com/news/russia-not-come-assad-rescue-172820336.html (''The Telegraph'' via Yahoo! News)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cwy8xzxe0w7t (BBC News)]
****[[United Nations]] [[Diplomatic rank#Special envoy|Special Envoy]] for Syria [[Geir Otto Pedersen]] calls for an "orderly political transition" from the collapsing [[government of Syria|Syrian government]] to the [[Syrian opposition]] in order to end the conflict. [https://apnews.com/article/syria-assad-sweida-daraa-homs-hts-qatar-7f65823bbf0a7bd331109e8dff419430 (AP)] [https://www.barrons.com/news/protesters-topple-statue-of-assad-s-father-in-damascus-suburb-witnesses-bb9c4ba3 (''Barron's'')]
****A statue of former Syrian president [[Hafez al-Assad]] is toppled in the Damascus suburb of Jaramana. [https://www.nbcnews.com/video/syrian-rebels-take-control-of-damascus-suburb-226468933570 (NBC News)] [https://www.barrons.com/news/protesters-topple-statue-of-assad-s-father-in-damascus-suburb-witnesses-bb9c4ba3 (''Barron's'')]
***[[Southern Syria offensive (2024)|Southern Syria offensive]]
****The [[Syrian Armed Forces]] announce a complete withdrawal from the [[Daraa Governorate|Daraa]] and [[Suwayda Governorate]]s in order to reinforce Damascus. [https://apnews.com/article/syria-assad-sweida-daraa-homs-hts-qatar-7f65823bbf0a7bd331109e8dff419430 (AP)]
****Rebel forces capture the city of [[Al-Sanamayn]] in Daraa Governorate and also capture the city of [[Quneitra]]. [https://www.firstpost.com/world/rebel-forces-just-20-km-away-from-syrian-capital-city-of-damascus-report-13842566.html (First Post)] [https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/syria-conflict-live-updates-syrian-civil-war-bashar-al-assad-december-7-2024-101733532224129.html (''The Hindustan Times'')] [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2024/12/07/syrian-opposition-forces-say-they-took-control-of-quneitra-near-israeli-border (Al Arabiya)]
***[[2024 Homs offensive]]
****Rebel forces enter the city of [[Homs]], eventually capturing the city after hours of [[urban warfare]] to oust Assad loyalists. Rebels also capture Homs Central Prison and release around 3,500 prisoners. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syrian-rebels-seize-fourth-city-close-homs-threat-assads-rule-2024-12-07/ (Reuters)] [https://www.timesnownews.com/world/middle-east/syria-rebels-capture-homs-celebrate-at-famous-clock-tower-watch-article-116088698 (Times Now)] [https://cedarnews.net/folders/newstasks/793569/video-the-homs-central-prison-has-been-captured-by-syrian-rebels/ (Cedar News)] [https://www.barrons.com/news/rebel-leader-in-syria-says-freed-3-500-prisoners-in-homs-57284915 (''Barron's'')]
***[[Deir ez-Zor offensive (2024)|Deir ez-Zor offensive]]
****More than 1,000 [[Syrian Army|Syrian soldiers]] seeking refuge cross into [[Iraq]] through the [[Al-Qa'im border crossing]] according to Iraqi authorities. [https://ina.iq/eng/36884-more-than-1000-syrian-soldiers-inside-iraqi-territory-says-senior-security-source.html (Iraqi News Agency)]
***[[Palmyra offensive (2024)|Palmyra offensive]]
****The U.S.-backed [[Revolutionary Commando Army]] takes control of the city of [[Palmyra (modern)|Palmyra]] in [[Homs Governorate]] following heavy fighting with [[Syrian Armed Forces|pro-government forces]]. Rebels also capture the towns of [[Al-Sukhnah, Syria|Al-Sukhnah]] and [[Al-Qaryatayn]] in Homs Governorate. [https://www.yenisafak.com/en/news/us-backed-syrian-free-army-takes-control-of-homs-palmyra-district-from-regime-forces-3695430 (Yeni Safak)]
***The [[Syrian Army]] withdraws from the cities of [[Al-Hasakah]] and [[Qamishli]] in [[Al-Hasakah Governorate]], transferring control of the Kurdish-majority cities to the Syrian Democratic Forces. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/syrian-regime-withdraws-from-east-of-euphrates/3417069 (Anadolu Agency)] [https://www.yenisafak.com/en/news/syrian-regime-withdraws-from-east-of-euphrates-3695426 (Yeni Safak)]
**[[Iranian intervention in the Syrian civil war]]
***[[Iran]] begins to evacuate [[Islamic Republic of Iran Armed Forces|military personnel]], diplomatic staff, and civilians from Syria amid rebel advances. [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/12/06/world/middleeast/iran-syria-evacuation.html (''The New York Times'')]
**[[Refugees of the Syrian civil war]]
***The [[UN]] [[World Food Programme]] reports that the renewed conflict in Syria is estimated to displace around 1.5 million [[Syrians]]. [https://aje.io/pq3n3i?update=3370395 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Attacks on refugee camps in the Gaza war]]
****At least 20 people, including six children, are killed in [[Israel]]i airstrikes on the [[Nuseirat refugee camp]] in [[Deir al-Balah Governorate]], [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://aje.io/y5lfzx (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Qatar]]i [[List of prime ministers of Qatar|Prime Minister]] [[Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani|Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani]] says at the [[Doha Forum]] that his country is seeing a momentum build up for a [[ceasefire]] to end the conflict between [[Israel]] and [[Hamas]] in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/7/qatari-pm-says-momentum-building-back-up-in-gaza-ceasefire-efforts (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Six [[Pakistan Army]] soldiers and 22 [[Pakistani Taliban|Tehreek-e-Taliban]] militants are killed in clashes near the [[Durand Line|Afghan border]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/six-pakistani-soldiers-killed-firefight-with-militants-army-says-2024-12-07/ (Reuters)]
**Six soldiers are killed and seven are injured after a [[mass shooting]] at a [[military checkpoint]] in [[Kurram District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-kurram-checkpoint-attack-taliban-e784f6cd506841decc0b8367ad4bb03f (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024–25 European windstorm season]]
**[[Storm Darragh]]
***Two people are killed by falling trees in [[England]] and more than 1.5 million people experience [[power outages]] in [[Ireland]] and the [[United Kingdom]] as Storm Darragh hits the [[British Isles]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1j00p3j2dpo (BBC News)] [https://news.sky.com/story/millions-urged-to-stay-inside-as-storm-darragh-hits-uk-and-ireland-with-rare-red-weather-warning-issued-13268433 (Sky News)]
*[[2024 The Hague explosion]]
**Five people are killed, four others are injured, and several others are missing in an explosion that destroyed several apartments in [[The Hague]], [[Netherlands]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/clykk717n1ko (BBC News)] [https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2024/12/08/at-least-five-killed-after-explosion-rips-through-apartment-in-dutch-city-the-hague (''Euronews'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Cross-strait relations]], [[Chinese intelligence activity abroad]]
**Prosecutors in [[Taiwan]] charge four [[Republic of China Armed Forces|soldiers]] with [[espionage]], accusing the soldiers of passing [[secret photography|photographs]] of Taiwan's [[military capability]] to [[China|Chinese]] [[Ministry of State Security (China)|agents]] in exchange for [[bribery|money]] between 2022 and 2024. [https://www.dw.com/en/taiwanese-soldiers-charged-with-spying-for-china/a-70980382 (DW)] [https://www.thestandard.com.hk/breaking-news/section/3/223519/Four-Taiwan-soldiers-charged-with-spying-for-China (''The Standard'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 South Korean martial law crisis]]
**[[Attempted impeachment of Yoon Suk Yeol]]
***A vote to impeach [[President of South Korea|South Korean president]] [[Yoon Suk Yeol]] fails in the [[National Assembly (South Korea)|National Assembly]] due to a [[boycott]] of the vote by members of Yoon's [[People Power Party (South Korea)|People Power Party]]. [https://apnews.com/article/south-korea-politics-yoon-martial-law-impeachment-3f2a9190bf5cec83b49e2c6ad5cf5379 (AP)]
**President Yoon Suk Yeol apologizes to the [[South Korea]]n population, promising that he will not avoid legal sanctions or institute [[martial law]] a second time. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/dec/07/south-korean-president-apologises-for-martial-law-attempt-as-impeachment-vote-looms (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2024 Indian farmers' protest]]
**Over 100 [[India]]n farmers march from [[Punjab, India|Punjab]] to the capital city [[New Delhi]] to demand for the legal assurance of a [[Minimum support price (India)|minimum support price]] for all crops as well as [[loan forgiveness]] for farmers. [https://www.dw.com/en/india-clashes-as-farmers-march-to-delhi-over-crop-prices/a-70983824 (DW)]
**[[Punjab Police (India)|Punjab Police]] set up [[barricade]]s and fire [[tear gas]] at the marching farmers as they enter [[Haryana]], causing them to turn around and return to [[Shambhu, Punjab|Shambhu]], Punjab. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/cities/chandigarh-news/punjab-farmers-halt-march-return-to-shambhu-protest-site-after-teargas-shelling-101733481768199.html (''Hindustan Times'')] [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/asia-pacific/police-use-tear-gas-to-block-farmers-march-toward-indian-capital/3416578 (Anadolu Agency)]
*[[2024 Ghanaian general election]]
**[[Ghanaians]] vote to elect the [[President of Ghana|President]] and the 275 members of the [[Parliament of Ghana|Parliament]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/video/20241207-ghana-votes-in-tight-election-amid-hopes-for-better-economic-times (France24)]
*[[2025 Singaporean general election]]
**Former [[Workers' Party (Singapore)|Workers' Party]] Secretary-General and longest-serving opposition [[member of parliament|Member]] of the [[Parliament of Singapore]] [[Low Thia Khiang]] announced retirement in politics ahead of the election. [https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore/former-workers-party-chief-low-thia-khiang-not-contesting-in-next-general-election (''The Straits Times'')] [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/singapore/former-workers-party-chief-low-thia-khiang-not-standing-general-election-4793036 (CNA)]
*Interim [[List of heads of state of Burkina Faso|President]] and [[Patriotic Movement for Safeguard and Restoration|military junta]] leader of [[Burkina Faso]] [[Ibrahim Traoré]] dismisses [[List of prime ministers of Burkina Faso|Prime Minister]] [[Apollinaire J. Kyélem de Tambèla]] and dissolves the government. [https://www.dw.com/en/burkina-faso-military-junta-dissolves-government/a-70989590 (DW)]  [https://www.irishexaminer.com/world/arid-41531900.html (''Irish Examiner'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*The [[Iranian Space Agency]] successfully launches the [[Simorgh (rocket)|Simorgh]] rocket carrying two satellites and the [[Saman-1 (rocket stage)|Saman-1]] [[space tug]] from the [[Imam Khomeini Space Launch Terminal]] in [[Semnan, Iran|Semnan]], [[Iran]], the heaviest [[payload]] ever launched in Iran. [https://www.dw.com/en/iran-launches-its-heaviest-ever-payload-into-space/a-70981129 (DW)]
